grammar.title: Expert uncertainty calibration
grammar.explain: German deploys verb-second and verb-final clause architecture, Konjunktiv I/II evidential distance, modal particles, nominalisation, information-structure fronting, register-sensitive compounds and pronominal reference. The model coordinates grammatical form with evidential commitment, information structure, social distance, and cohesion; mediation must preserve these relations.
grammar.pattern: stance frame + scoped proposition + cohesive qualification

examples.t: Nicht die Entscheidung allein war ausschlaggebend; vielmehr veränderte gerade die Art ihrer Umsetzung das Ergebnis.

examples.en: The decision alone was not decisive; rather, precisely the manner of its implementation changed the outcome.
